fact: On 3 December 2024 Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Telecom Group signed an MoU in Addis Ababa for the Horizon Fiber Initiative, a terrestrial fibre link interconnecting Ethiopia, Djibouti and Sudan.
title: Strategic Partnership Announced Among Ethio telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel Telecom Group for the Horizon Fiber Initiative
